CLASS:  BBA   SEMESTER : VI
BRANCH: MANAGEMENT   SESSION : SP/2025

SUBJECT: MT325 PERFORMANCE AND COMPENSATION
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1(a) Organizations  implement  Performance  Management  Systems  (PMS)  not  only  to
evaluate  employee  performance  but  also  to  drive  continuous  improvement  and
strategic alignment. Discuss the key purposes of a PMS in an applied organizational
context.
[2] 1 1,2
Q.1(b) Explain  goal  setting  theory  and  elucidate how  can  managers  effectively  apply  this
theory to enhance employee productivity?
[3] 1 1,2


Q.2(a) Explain any five traditional performance appraisal methods. [2] 1,3 1
Q.2(b) The primary purpose of performance appraisals is to improve employee performance,
then why do many organizations struggle to make them impactful?
[3] 1 3


Q.3(a) You are an HR manager at a growing tech startup. The company wants to implement
a structured performance management process to improve employee productivity and
career development. Outline and apply the key steps of the performance management
process to design an effective system for the organization.
[2] 1,2 4
Q.3(b) A newly established tech startup is looking to implement a performance management
process. As an HR consultant, what key prerequisites must the organization establish
before launching the system.
[3] 1,2 2


Q.4(a) Write a detailed note on Victor Vrooms expectancy theory. [2] 1 1
Q.4(b) Differentiate between performance appraisal and performance management. [3] 1 3


Q.5(a) How can performance planning process be implemented in organizations. [2] 4 1,2
Q.5(b) Write  a  detailed  note  on  360-degree  appraisal.  Also  enlist  its  advantages  and
disadvantages.
[3] 2 3
